content: The dashboard tab just goes completely blank for me. It started this morning.
Does it happen every time you open the dashboard, or only after doing something specific?
Only after I delete a workflow. I deleted an old test workflow from the list, and right after that the whole dashboard went white. Refreshing fixes it until I delete another one.
Did you catch anything in the browser console when it went blank?
There was a red error, something about reading 'status' of undefined. I copied part of it into a text file, attaching it. It mentioned MetricsPanel.
Thanks — one more thing: does the blank screen happen if the deleted workflow was NOT visible in the metrics panel's time window?
Good question. The test workflow I deleted was definitely in this week's window, it was showing in the chart. A teammate deleted a months-old workflow yesterday and said nothing broke for them.
